abstract.para: This article gives some brief instructions on installing FreeBSD 12.2-RELEASE and upgrading the systems running earlier releases.

sect1.title: Installing FreeBSD
sect1.para: The Installing FreeBSD chapter of the FreeBSD Handbook provides more in-depth information about the installation program itself, including a guided walk-through with screenshots.

sect1.title: Upgrading FreeBSD
sect1.para: If you are upgrading from a previous release of FreeBSD, please read upgrading section in the Release Notes for notable incompatibilities carefully.

sect2.title: Upgrading from Source
sect2.para: The procedure for doing a source code based update is described in Updating FreeBSD from Source.
For SVN use the releng/12.2 branch which will be where any upcoming Security Advisories or Errata Notices will be applied.

sect2.title: Upgrading Using FreeBSD Update

The system must now be rebooted with the newly installed kernel before the non-kernel components are updated.
